cohort.memory: original selected outcome counts independent per family/role across three dev seeds, scene novelty set resets per episode, state checkpoint preserved
cohort.first_use: now exposed development identities, never independently sealed heldout

mechanism.label: Engineered mission-conditioned public symbolic scene novelty-prediction and optimistic selection; no learned semantics or physical localization
mechanism.original_base: unchanged source import of MG47 DoorMemoryNavigation, MG44 public release FSM, exact original MG54 mission outcome event detector; parent selects source action first
mechanism.scene: Sort all source-public 7x7 image cell triples for nonfloor object types2 wall,4 door,5 key,6 ball,7 box,8 goal and other nonempty except 1 floor. Include literal mission string; discard public heading and arrangement. A scene novelty event occurs only when after source-public scene key differs from *all previously seen this original episode*. This is a manually engineered visual signature, not a true new room or discovered causal entity.
mechanism.state: Reuse source-original MG54 pooled public mission/front object type/door state/visible exact target summary; original 7 actions unchanged
mechanism.memory: For each selected original context+action0-6 record [selected_count,selected_novel_scene_count,own_selected_immediate_source_goal_effect_mass], max 2048 unique keys per family; both arms learn identically on their own selected source path; reset episode scene-hash set on each original reset
mechanism.credit: Use original MG54 source public first target appearance +2, actual selected locked door opening +3, source target pickup disappearance +6 and positive terminal goal +10. Immediate own selected step only; no artificial future reward, hidden location or scripted route.
mechanism.policy: Original MG47 chooses first. In phase seek and original parent action left/right/forward and exact visible target not front, after >=2 original source-selected trials in the same publicly engineered coarse context, compare available actions left/right/forward. For candidate action n, estimated scene-new=(novel_count+1)/(n+2), estimated public goal-effect=2*goal_effect_mass/(n+2), and uncertainty bonus=0.5*sqrt(2*log(1+total context selected samples)/(n+1)); score sum. Choose highest score, ties prefer original then lowest action. Override only when best differs from parent and score exceeds parent by >=0.125. Original front wall, any door or portable object forbids forward. Never override original MG44 release/retry, pickup, drop, toggle or selected target-front mission action.
mechanism.ablation: same original source-visible outcomes and cold checkpoint policy, but steering_enabled=false; zero override, compare unchanged MG47 same DEV action trace
mechanism.limitations: The novel semantic signature can alias spatially different observations; UCB bonus is an engineered exploration prior, not native self-learning. Scene novelty alone is not mission progress or scientifically proven causal discovery.

metrics.primary: True original positive terminal goals and exact target first encounters in both larger KeyCorridors and ObstructedMaze
metrics.secondary: source selected goal pickups, real original locked-door openings, source public scene novelty, learned own selected action outcome samples, valid real policy overrides, checkpoint retention, resource and action counts
metrics.comparators: same model policy OFF; unchanged MG54 ON/OFF; unchanged MG52, MG50, MG47, MG44; original MG34 model-based lookahead, MG33 frontier and independently verified MG33C UCB; untouched Wingless and Yggdrasil MG19
metrics.resources: original selected action denominators, auxiliary measured wall/Python/child CPU; no full native Go RSS/energy parity

at least one authentic positive terminal original goal episode in a larger KeyCorridor family
at least one authentic positive original terminal goal in ObstructedMaze
candidate total original positive goals strictly greater than each prereg comparator including matched steering disabled
